title: Contract-Year Step-Down of the Early Termination Fee (Paystride Earned Wage Access Program Agreement)
content:
The early termination fee of the Paystride Earned Wage Access Program Agreement declines with the contract year. Counting the whole months from the signed date to the notice date, a month counting as whole only once the day of the month of the signed date is reached, or on the first day of the next month where that month has no such day:

| Whole months from the signed date to the notice date | Fee multiplied by |
|---|---|
| at least 24 | 0.4 |
| at least 12 but fewer than 24 | 0.7 |
| fewer than 12 | not multiplied |

Boundary cases (hypothetical): signed on the 18th of a month, a notice given on the 18th of the month 24 months later counts 24 whole months and takes 0.4; a notice given on the 17th of that month counts 23 and takes 0.7; a notice given on the 17th of the month 12 months after signing counts 11 and is not multiplied.
